title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: International graduate students, young professionals, and artists
deadline: Varies by country (typically Feb - Oct annually)
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, Airfare, Living Stipend, Health Insurance)
description: Enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States.

title: Google Software Engineering Internship 2025
eligibility: Students currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related field
qualification: Experience in Java, C++, Python, or Go
description: Work on real-world engineering projects alongside experienced Googlers to build products that impact billions of users.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML/CSS, React, or Vanilla JS
description: Build modern web applications, sites, and interfaces across Canonical's ecosystem including Ubuntu and cloud tools.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school or higher education
qualification: Enrolled student status with an innovative tech solution
description: Global student technology competition where teams build innovative solutions using AI and Microsoft Azure.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: New graduates and young professionals with up to 2 years experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in any technical or business field
description: Rotational program designed to train future product leaders through hands-on experience on core Meta products.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with an internet connection
description: An entry-level course teaching fundamental computer science concepts, algorithmic thinking, and programming languages like C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
